__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus with native soju and optional soju-admin jobs.

description: Operational overview of Soju IRC bouncer metrics. Scrape status measures Prometheus access to the exporter; upstream failures are tracked separately. Based on the dashboard distributed with soju-tui.

panels.description: Prometheus can scrape every selected Soju target. This does not assert that every upstream IRC network is connected.
panels.title: Scrape status

panels.description: Current active Soju users across the selected targets.
panels.title: Users

panels.description: Connected upstream connections across the selected Soju processes. Each user/network connection counts separately.
panels.title: Networks up

panels.description: Current active IRC client connections to Soju.
panels.title: Clients

panels.description: Configured networks, including disabled networks. Available with SQLite or PostgreSQL through the optional admin collector. Optional read-only soju_admin collector required; failed, missing, or older-than-120-second collections show N/A. Counts are summed across selected instances and user/network configurations, not unique IRC networks or unique channel names.

targets.expr: sum(soju_admin_networks_configured{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (soju_admin_collection_success{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (time() - soju_admin_collected_timestamp_seconds{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} < 120) and on(job, instance) (up{job="soju-admin"} == 1) and on(soju_instance) label_replace(up{job="soju", instance=~"$instance"}, "soju_instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Networks total

panels.description: Elapsed time since Soju started. With All selected, this card shows the shortest uptime across selected processes; the uptime chart shows each instance. Restarting Soju resets process uptime and its native counters.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Channels currently joined on connected upstreams, reported by Soju's live network status. Detached downstream views still count if the bouncer remains joined. Optional read-only soju_admin collector required; failed, missing, or older-than-120-second collections show N/A. Counts are summed across selected instances and user/network configurations, not unique IRC networks or unique channel names.

targets.expr: sum(soju_admin_channels_joined{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (soju_admin_collection_success{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (time() - soju_admin_collected_timestamp_seconds{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} < 120) and on(job, instance) (up{job="soju-admin"} == 1) and on(soju_instance) label_replace(up{job="soju", instance=~"$instance"}, "soju_instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Channels joined

panels.description: Saved channel records. A saved channel may be parted or belong to a disabled network, so this differs from channels joined. Optional read-only soju_admin collector required; failed, missing, or older-than-120-second collections show N/A. Counts are summed across selected instances and user/network configurations, not unique IRC networks or unique channel names.

targets.expr: sum(soju_admin_channels_configured{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (soju_admin_collection_success{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (time() - soju_admin_collected_timestamp_seconds{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} < 120) and on(job, instance) (up{job="soju-admin"} == 1) and on(soju_instance) label_replace(up{job="soju", instance=~"$instance"}, "soju_instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Channels saved

panels.description: Configured networks explicitly disabled; these do not retry until re-enabled. Optional read-only soju_admin collector required; failed, missing, or older-than-120-second collections show N/A. Counts are summed across selected instances and user/network configurations, not unique IRC networks or unique channel names.

targets.expr: sum(soju_admin_networks_disabled{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (soju_admin_collection_success{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (time() - soju_admin_collected_timestamp_seconds{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} < 120) and on(job, instance) (up{job="soju-admin"} == 1) and on(soju_instance) label_replace(up{job="soju", instance=~"$instance"}, "soju_instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Networks paused

panels.description: Enabled networks currently disconnected. This is a current outage count, unlike historical failed connection attempts. Optional read-only soju_admin collector required; failed, missing, or older-than-120-second collections show N/A. Counts are summed across selected instances and user/network configurations, not unique IRC networks or unique channel names.

targets.expr: sum(soju_admin_networks_disconnected{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (soju_admin_collection_success{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(job, instance, soju_instance) (time() - soju_admin_collected_timestamp_seconds{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} < 120) and on(job, instance) (up{job="soju-admin"} == 1) and on(soju_instance) label_replace(up{job="soju", instance=~"$instance"}, "soju_instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Networks down

panels.description: Current Soju users, upstream IRC connections, and downstream client connections.
panels.title: Active connections

panels.description: IRC messages received from and sent to upstream IRC servers per second. Counts IRC protocol messages, including protocol traffic, rather than chat messages alone.
panels.title: Upstream message rate

panels.description: IRC messages received from and sent to downstream IRC clients per second. Counts IRC protocol messages, including protocol traffic, rather than chat messages alone.
panels.title: Downstream message rate

panels.description: Failed upstream connection attempts and worker panics per second. Each failed retry contributes another attempt; these rates are not counts of currently disconnected networks.
panels.title: Reliability event rate

panels.description: Estimated failed attempts and worker panics within the selected dashboard time range, calculated with increase() and rounded for display. Repeated retries of one upstream count separately. These are historical events, not the number of networks currently offline.
panels.title: Events in selected range

panels.description: Per-instance Soju process CPU utilization in CPU cores.
panels.title: Process CPU

panels.description: Resident memory held by each selected Soju process.
panels.title: Resident memory

panels.description: Go goroutines and heap allocation for the selected Soju process. Values use separate axes because their units differ.
panels.title: Go runtime

panels.description: Historical sum of the selected Soju processes' counters since their individual process starts. Counters reset when their process restarts. This is not a current outage count. Each failed retry of the same upstream increments the counter again.
panels.title: Failed attempts since start

panels.description: Historical sum of the selected Soju processes' counters since their individual process starts. Counters reset when their process restarts. This is not a current outage count.
panels.title: Worker panics since start

panels.description: Seconds elapsed since each selected Soju process started. A drop to zero indicates a process restart; upstream reconnects do not reset this value.
panels.title: Soju uptime by instance

panels.description: Fresh means the optional read-only collector succeeded within 120 seconds and its private exporter is reachable. Stale or failed collections are excluded from network/channel cards. Missing collectors show N/A, not zero.

targets.expr: min((soju_admin_collection_success{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"} * on(job, instance, soju_instance) ((time() - soju_admin_collected_timestamp_seconds{job="soju-admin", soju_instance=~"$instance"}) < bool 120) * on(job, instance) group_left up{job="soju-admin"}) and on(soju_instance) label_replace(up{job="soju", instance=~"$instance"}, "soju_instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Counts collector

title: Soju IRC Bouncer
